cover_headline: Jailer 2 Crosses Rs 800 Crore, a First for Tamil Cinema
facts: Sacnilk put the worldwide gross at Rs 807.25 crore after day 18: Rs 533.75 crore in India and Rs 273.50 crore overseas
The film became the highest-grossing Tamil film in India, passing 2.0's domestic gross
Overseas markets supplied roughly a third of the total — North America and the Gulf remain central to a Tamil film's record run

end.headline: Jailer 2 Crosses Rs 800 Crore, a First for Tamil Cinema
end.line: Trade trackers put Rajinikanth's sequel at Rs 800-807 crore worldwide after 18 days, with overseas markets supplying about a third of the gross.
